notes.title: 🛠️ Game Update - Bug Fixes and Improvements 🎉
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

We are excited to announce the release of a new update for our game. In this update, we have fixed a bug that some players encountered when purchasing film in the inventory. This feature now works correctly and without errors.

We also fixed the names of items in the inventory to make your gaming experience more comfortable and understandable.

Thank you for your support and patience! Please continue to share your feedback so we can further improve the game.

Best regards,
Furry Tails Team

notes.title: Hello, dear furheads! We've got something for you! 🎁
notes.content:
A new release is already there! Although it took us some time to get back from the big pause, and some of our fans didn't enjoy certain decisions we made in the recent Furry Hitler 2 - we listened to everyone. We've worked on fixing certain aspects, and while the previous release was a nod to our original community, this one is a new, original idea. Not only fresh but hot and filled with a summer atmosphere, just as the time of the year suggests - welcome to the FURRY Sex Resort 🏝🔞!
- Compete in a strict world of nude photography
- Build important relationships and find a way to everyone's soul
- Immerse yourself in a storyline weaved around connections, tension
- Hot summer vibes and summer hotties vibe 😉

Jump on the game page and see for yourself! You also might get in time for a little bonus - who knows?
